race.description: Gravelista - Uci Gravel World Series Sun 25 Oct Mdn Plate
race.comment: MORE FOXIE (3) looks close to win at the third time of asking. He's placed in both runs to date and getting to a mile here looks ideal on the quick turnaround. He'll land in a great spot and go close. BRILLIANT BULL ANT (1) is knocking on the door having found one better in his past three starts. Possibly lacks the upside off a few but he'll take holding out. DANCE DAY (10) is a gelding by Noverre for the Williams yard who debuts. Wary with Willo booked, watch betting. RIVERLEA PRINCE (4) has been good in his two runs back this time, both over a mile where he was beaten less than a length. That effort stacks up in this field and he can feature again.
